claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures 14 CFR § 91.107(a)(1), prohibiting a pilot from taking off a U.S.-registered civil aircraft (except specified free balloons and airships) unless the PIC ensures each person on board is briefed on fastening and unfastening safety belts and shoulder harnesses, subject to Administrator authorization.

Claim C0001 accurately conveys 14 CFR § 91.107(a)(2), requiring that before surface movement, takeoff, or landing, the PIC must ensure passengers are notified to fasten safety belts and shoulder harnesses.
Claim C0002 precisely represents the general seating and safety belt requirement under 14 CFR § 91.107(a)(3) for each person on board during movement on the surface, takeoff, and landing.
Claim C0003 accurately reflects the exemption in § 91.107(a)(3) for dock personnel pushing off or mooring seaplanes or float-equipped rotorcraft during surface movement.
Claim C0004 accurately states the lap child permission under § 91.107(a)(3)(i), including the age limit (under 2 years old), no restraining device condition, and the cross-reference to § 91.108(j).
Claim C0005 accurately states the permission in § 91.107(a)(3)(ii) for sport parachutists to use the aircraft floor as a seat.
Claim C0006 covers the overarching permission under § 91.107(a)(3)(iii) for a child to occupy an approved child restraint system, including accompanying adult and labeling/operator conditions.

Claim C0007 faithfully captures the mandatory labeling requirement in § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(B)(1) for child restraint seats manufactured to U.S. standards between January 1, 1981, and February 25, 1985.
Claim C0008 captures § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(B)(2) regarding the two required labels for seats manufactured to U.S. standards on or after February 26, 1985.

Claim C0009 accurately groups and represents the alternative qualifying labeling/markings under § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(B)(3) for seats not qualifying under (B)(1) or (B)(2), covering UN standards, FAA TC/STC, and FAA § 21.8(d)/TSO C-100b approvals.
Claim C0010 correctly preserves the specific grandfathering permission under § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(B)(3)(iv) for the AmSafe CARES device (Part No. 4082) approved under § 21.305(d) (2010 ed.).
Claim C0011 correctly represents the prohibition/non-approval in § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(B)(4) of booster-type, vest-, harness-, and lap-held child restraints, including its exceptions.
Claim C0012 accurately captures the operator duty under § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(C)(1) to ensure the child restraint is properly secured to an approved forward-facing seat or berth.
Claim C0013 accurately captures § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(C)(2) regarding securing the child in the restraint system and adhering to the weight limit.
Claim C0014 accurately captures the operator requirement under § 91.107(a)(3)(iii)(C)(3) to ensure the restraint system bears the appropriate label(s).
Claim C0015 correctly captures the general exclusion in § 91.107(b) for operations conducted under 14 CFR parts 121, 125, or 135.
Claim C0016 correctly captures § 91.107(b) providing that paragraph (a)(3) does not apply to persons subject to § 91.105.
